parameters.name: FallbackTarget
parameters.description: The name of the baseline swim lane for the group. This parameter is used only if the group operates in loose mode.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the swim lane group.

parameters.name: IngressRoutingStrategy
parameters.description:
The policy for routing requests to the swim lanes in the group. Valid values:

- `weighted`: Specifies a weight-based routing policy. Requests that match a single, group-wide routing rule are routed to different swim lanes based on specified weights.

- `rule-based`: Specifies a rule-based routing policy. Each swim lane has its own routing rule. A request is forwarded to a swim lane only if it matches that swim lane's routing rule.

parameters.name: ServiceLevelFallbackTarget
parameters.description: This parameter is not in use.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh instance.

parameters.name: ServicesList
parameters.description: The list of services associated with the swim lane group.

parameters.name: WeightedIngressRule
parameters.description: The routing rule for the entire swim lane group. This parameter is used when the group's routing policy is `weighted`.
